subject: AcreetionOS Update — July 16, 2026
body:
A significant update to our continuous integration pipeline has just been implemented, with the addition of per-pipeline staging directories to avoid publish races between concurrent builds, and relative symlinks for the latest.iso file, making our ISO build process more reliable. This enhancement is a direct result of our community's efforts to refine and stabilize our workflow, ensuring that our users receive the most up-to-date and stable versions of AcreetionOS, which can be found on our website at https://acreetionos.org/.

Development
Our development team has been working hard to improve the overall stability and security of AcreetionOS, with recent updates including the latest stable kernel set, which can be viewed in our changelog at https://acreetionos.org/changelog.html. Additionally, our community has been actively engaged in discussions and contributions, including the release of Emacs 31.1, which is now available for installation using pacman, our package manager.

Community
The AcreetionOS community has been thriving, with many users contributing to our wiki at https://acreetionos.org/wiki.html, and sharing their knowledge and experiences with others. Our documentation at https://acreetionos.org/docs.html is also being constantly updated and improved, providing users with a comprehensive resource for learning and troubleshooting. For those looking to get started with AcreetionOS, our flash guide at https://acreetionos.org/flash.html is a great place to begin.
